description: The exact amount of financial support granted to each selected entity under the GRAIL Genesis Open Call is a fixed lump sum of up to €100,000 per project, distributed across three stages over a maximum of 8 months. The Genesis Open Call will select at least 10 projects. Beneficiaries must be individual entities — SMEs, startups, mid-caps, large companies, or Research and Technology Organisations — acting as data providers and/or data-collection-tool developers.

callTitle: GRAIL Open Call — Genesis (1st Open Call)
furtherInformation: GRAIL aims to deliver the first European general-purpose Foundational Robotics Model (GFRM). The project's results will be validated across five industrial Use Cases — automotive, aerospace, intralogistics, steel and electronics, and scaled through more than 40 third-party projects funded across three sequential Open Calls (Genesis, Ascent, Summit) to accelerate data generation, model fine-tuning and industrial adoption.

projectName: Generative Robotics & AI for EU Industrial Leadership
Página de la convocatoria (requisitos):
Target applicants:
SMEs, startups, mid-caps, large companies, or Research and Technology Organisations (RTOs) — acting as data providers and/or developers of data-collection tools (hardware and/or software), to receive funding and support.
Applicants must be legal entities established in an EU Member State, Iceland, Norway, or an eligible associated country (Canada, Israel, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Switzerland, United Kingdom)
Eligible activities
Eligible activities must focus on creating or improving the data assets that will feed the GRAIL foundation model. The indicative activities that qualify for financial support are the following:
Generalist Data Foundations: Creation of broad datasets across robots and tasks, capturing primitive skills (grasping, pushing, insertion, handover) with multimodal sensors. Emphasis on lab-scale but diverse conditions, including rigid, deformable, and cluttered interactions, to serve as transferable baselines for later UCs.
Successful applicants will also be enrolled in the GRAIL Mentoring Programme and supported by GRAIL's technical coaches.
